initial_detector_definition: Case-insensitive basename LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE with optional dot, hyphen, or underscore suffix; depth <=3 below package root. Full-tree scan used the same basename pattern and still found zero such paths in the 17. Text content and alternate names required separate inspection.
